articles.title: Double murderer given extra 22 years for historical sexual assaults
articles.summary: A former Royal Navy petty officer who is serving a life sentence for two murders has been jailed for a further 22 years for sexually assaulting three young naval recruits and a 14-year-old boy in the 1990s.

articles.title: Two men charged with murder after death of non-league footballer
articles.summary: Two men have been charged with murder after the death of a non-league footballer.

articles.title: Premier League footballer sparks police operation after bow and arrow sighting
articles.summary: Newcastle United's Bosnian full-back Amar Dedic reportedly found himself at the centre of a major police response after he was spotted carrying a bow and arrows in the countryside.

articles.title: Poundland owner seeks private MP session 'to avoid show trial'
articles.summary: Poundland's owner is seeking to give evidence to MPs in private next week as it seeks to avoid an evidence session on the discount retailer's fate turning into "a show trial".

articles.title: Two 16 year olds charged after five boys seriously injured at Halloween party
articles.summary: Two 16 year olds have been charged after five boys were seriously injured at a party on Halloween.

articles.title: Andrew made more than £2,000 a month subletting Royal Lodge cottages
articles.summary: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor received more than £2,000 a month from renting out three cottages at his former Royal Lodge home, a report by the public spending watchdog has revealed.

articles.title: Brand faces 'significant' prison term after rape and sexual assault conviction
articles.summary: Russell Brand has been told by a judge that he faces a "significant custodial term" after being found guilty of rape and sexual assault.

articles.title: Meghan's brother a 'person of interest' in child abuse image claims
articles.summary: Meghan Markle's half brother has been named as a "person of interest" in an investigation into child sexual abuse image allegations against the Duchess of Sussex's father.

articles.title: Seven arrests after paramedics attacked with fireworks and police van set alight
articles.summary: At least seven people have been arrested across Scotland after a police vehicle was set alight and officers and paramedics were attacked with fireworks.
